description: This file implements thread identity management functions for the Abseil library, including thread-local storage setup, thread identity allocation, and retrieval functions.

methods.name: AllocateThreadIdentityKey
methods.description: Creates a pthread key for thread identity and sets the initialization flag.

methods.name: SetCurrentThreadIdentity
methods.description: Associates a ThreadIdentity object with the current thread, using different mechanisms based on configuration.

methods.name: ClearCurrentThreadIdentity
methods.description: Clears the thread's current ThreadIdentity pointer.

methods.name: CurrentThreadIdentityIfPresent
methods.description: Returns the current thread's ThreadIdentity if set, otherwise nullptr.
